DSH plugin collection: publishing and distribution for workspace plugins

A traffic light under the composer plus a desktop floating window that shows whether DSH tasks are running, waiting for you, or finished.

description.en: A2A interop bridge for the Harness: serves it as an A2A agent on both the v1.0 and 0.3.x wire formats (auto-detected), drives a real DSH session per inbound message, and adds four a2a_* tools that discover and call remote A2A agents. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: A2A 双向互通：把本机 Harness 同时以 v1.0 与 0.3.x 两代线格式对外提供 Agent Card、JSON-RPC 与 SSE（自动判别），每条入站消息驱动一个真实 DSH 会话，并提供四个 a2a_* 工具调用远端 A2A 智能体。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Import conversations from local Codex, Pi, and Claude Code histories into DSH, then continue them with the full transcript or a detailed summary.

description.en: Fixed review pipelines for a workspace: each step fires when the agent finishes the last one, and the flow pauses only where you said it should.
description.zh: 给工作区配固定评审流程：agent 做完上一步就自动发出下一步，只在你指定的地方停下来等你。

description.en: Defines DSH agent modes as real presets, each with its own persona, tool set and mounted plugins, including a pure mode that starts with no capability at all.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的智能体模式定义成真正的预设：每个模式有自己的角色设定、工具集与插件挂载，并提供一个完全不加载任何能力的 pure 模式。

description.en: Restyles only the model answers in the DSH Web UI: font family, body and heading weight, and a color for bold runs, with a one-click reset. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 只给 DSH 的模型回答换字体、调正文与标题字重、给加粗片段上色，随时一键恢复默认。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A Linux system-tray status dot for DeepSeek Harness sessions: green when idle, grey while a session runs, yellow while one is waiting for your answer or permission, with a middle click that jumps to the earliest waiting session. The tray is installed by install.sh; the bundled DSH plugin adds the settings toggle and the click-to-jump handler.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linux 系统托盘状态灯：绿=全部空闲，灰=有会话在跑，黄=有会话在等你回答或批准权限；中键点击跳到最早待确认的会话。托盘由 install.sh 安装，随包提供的 DSH 插件负责设置页开关与点击跳转。

description.en: Remote control of DeepSeek Harness from a phone browser: scan a QR code, confirm the device on the computer, then chat, answer tool approvals and preview workspace files in the host's own web interface. Connects over the same Wi-Fi (with an optional https domain) or through a self-hosted public relay node.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器远程控制电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在宿主自己的网页界面里对话、处理工具审批、预览工作区文件；支持同一局域网（可配域名 HTTPS）或经自托管公网中转节点接入。

description.en: Local WebRTC chat for DeepSeek Harness with channels, nicknames, SQLite history, and custom emojis.

It embeds Tencent's official openclaw-weixin plugin through an OpenClaw host compatibility layer instead of reimplementing the WeChat protocol.
description.zh: 把微信 ClawBot（腾讯 iLink）接入 DeepSeek Harness：在 DSH Web 里扫码登录，每个微信用户一个持久 DSH 会话，支持会话/模型/工作区指令，并把工具审批转发到微信。它通过 OpenClaw 宿主兼容层嵌入腾讯官方 openclaw-weixin 插件，而不是重写微信协议。

description.en: Shows the live payload size of the current conversation on the answer action row, with warn and danger colors and a one-click handoff that writes a handoff document and leaves a prompt in a new session. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在每条回答的动作行显示当前会话的上下文体积，越线变色，并可一键写交接文档、新建会话并把指令预填进输入框（不自动发送）。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Expandable tree of one agent session's context: rounds, model steps, tool calls, subagents, session naming, compaction and search, with each call's input, output, token usage, cache hit rate and timing on click.
description.zh: 把一次 agent 会话的上下文收成可展开的树：轮次、模型步骤、工具调用、子会话、会话命名、上下文压缩与检索，点开每个节点可看这次调用的输入、输出、token 用量、缓存命中率与耗时。

description.en: Heuristic cost preflight for a draft message before it is sent. Message length over 500 characters, multi-step keywords, more than three referenced file paths, and test/verify/deploy words each add one tier (0-1 low, 2 medium, 3+ high), scaled by loose/standard/aggressive thresholds. Shows a 500ms-debounced tier badge beside the send button, a one-line high-cost hint above the input, an enable switch, a settings card, and exposes a cost_preflight tool. No token counting and no model calls.
description.zh: 发送前的启发式成本预检：草稿超过 500 字、含循环/遍历/逐个/所有/批量/接着/然后/之后等多步关键词、引用文件路径超过 3 个、含测试/验证/部署各加一档（0–1 低、2 中、3+ 高），宽松/标准/激进三档只移动切线；发送按钮旁显示 500ms 防抖的档位标签，高成本时在输入框上方给一行提示，另有启用开关、设置卡片与 cost_preflight 工具。不做 token 精确计费，不调用模型。

description.en: KB-first optical-engineering task assistant. opticforge_assist aligns a concrete problem with the 40-section / 324-entry knowledge base before any web search. 3.1.1 activates up to three topic playbooks (16 cards, 98 dimension declarations), retrieves evidence per required dimension, and returns a dimension-by-source coverage matrix, a gated plan with dimension IDs and cross-check steps, formula cards, a five-section report outline and acceptance checks. Answers explain principle -> formula/criterion -> approach -> steps, and never expose KB layer or entry IDs; sources are named as documents, standards, manuals or URLs. web_gate allows external search only for declared KB gaps, standard versions, vendor parameters or price timeliness. opticforge_verify checks KB alignment, present-only citations, dimension evidence, cross-relations, source tiering, KB conflicts, 30-day freshness and five-section presentation, and reports an adoption gate. Includes 308 concept cards, 6 generic dimensions, 19 formula cards and the opticforge-task DSH Skill. 308 entries are citable; 16 declared gaps remain, limited to A03, C01 and E01 verbatim sources. Five tools, zero runtime dependencies, no calculator, no network access and no action execution by the plugin. npm publication is on hold; install from GitHub with node scripts/install-local.mjs.
description.zh: KB-first 光学工程任务辅助。opticforge_assist 在任何联网检索之前，先把具体问题与 40 个板块、324 条知识库对齐。3.1.1 最多激活 3 张主题卡（16 张卡、98 条维度声明），按必需维度分别取证，并返回“维度×来源”覆盖矩阵、带 dimension_id 与交叉复核步骤的门禁计划、公式卡、五段报告骨架与验收清单。回答按“原理 → 公式/判据 → 思路 → 步骤”展开，不暴露知识库层级或条目编号；来源只写文献、标准、手册或 URL 名称。web_gate 仅在 KB 缺口、标准版本、厂商参数或价格时效条件下放行外部检索。opticforge_verify 检查 KB 对齐、仅引用 present 条目、维度证据、交叉关系、来源分级、KB 冲突、30 天时效与五段呈现，并给出采信闸门结论。包含 308 张概念卡、6 个通用维度、19 张公式卡与 opticforge-task DSH Skill；308 条可引用，16 条明示缺口仍限于 A03、C01、E01 的原始条文。共五个工具，零运行时依赖、无计算器；插件不联网、不执行动作。npm 暂不发布，从 GitHub 克隆后运行 node scripts/install-local.mjs 安装。

description.en: Trims the tool surface per session. Each session owns a profile — a tool whitelist — applied through `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ allow })` on that agent scope only, and switching one session never touches another; `full` is the built-in no-restriction profile. The provider only picks the default: a session created or switched onto a local provider (explicit `localProvider`, `routes`, a loopback/private baseURL, or a local-ish id) gets the `local` profile, a cloud one gets `full`, and the re-plan runs on model-selection events plus one delayed pass because the projection can land after the event. Profiles are editable from the panel and persisted under `~/.dsh/plugin-trim-state.json`; an explicit per-session choice overrides the provider default until cleared. A separate, opt-in layer physically disables whole plugin entries through `pluginManager.setPluginEnabled` — that one is profile-scoped by API and the panel labels it as such rather than pretending it can be per-session. A `tool_trim` tool exposes list/status/profile/set/apply/restore to the model. The panel is served by a loopback-only HTTP server the plugin starts on its own fixed port — `http://127.0.0.1:12256/` (auto-bumps on collision, configurable) — because the DSH port changes on every restart and a locally linked package gets no market card in the sidebar; it lists live sessions with their profile and tool count, an editor per profile, a provider picker limited to providers declared in the profile or currently in use, and the full plugin list with search and paging. Two implementation details worth knowing: `tools.restrict()` is an intersection and cannot widen, so the old restriction is released before the visible set is read — otherwise switching to a bigger profile would shrink instead of grow; and every disposer is registered on `ctx.effect`, without which a hot reload leaves an unremovable restriction behind. Measured on a 12GB laptop GPU with a 27B model and a fully resident 256K cache, same conversation: 105 tools / 56,306 prompt tokens / 22.5 tok/s decode, 62 / 34,207 / 43.0 after disabling three tool-heavy plugins, 14 / 12,890 / 66.8 after a session moved to the local profile, with prefill rising from 487 to 1,310 tok/s. Restricting also drops the skill catalog injection, roughly 4.3K more tokens. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 按会话裁工具面。每个会话自己拥有一个档位（一份工具白名单），通过 `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ allow })` 只作用在该 agent 上，给一个会话换档不会碰其它会话；`full` 是内置的「不限制」档。provider 只负责挑默认档：新建或切到本地 provider 的会话（`localProvider` 写死、`routes` 命中、baseURL 落在回环或私有网段、或 id 带本地标记）套 `local`，云端会话套 `full`；重排挂在模型选择事件上，并补一次延迟重排，因为选择投影可能比事件晚一拍。档位可在面板里编辑，存在 `~/.dsh/plugin-trim-state.json`；会话自己的显式选择优先于 provider 默认，直到你点「跟随 provider」。另有一层可选的插件物理开关，走 `pluginManager.setPluginEnabled` —— 它按 API 就是 profile 作用域，面板如实标注，不假装能按会话关插件。模型侧还有 `tool_trim`（list/status/profile/set/apply/restore）。面板由插件自己托管在 `GET /api/plugin-trim/panel`，另有十个 POST 接口并做同源校验（本地 link 安装的包在 DSH 侧栏拿不到市场卡片，所以面板不能只挂在插件详情页）：列出现场会话及其档位与工具数、每个档位的编辑器、只列「profile 里声明过的 + 当前正在用的」provider 选择器，以及带搜索分页的全部插件列表。两个实现细节值得知道：`tools.restrict()` 是求交集、不能变宽，所以换档前必须先撤掉旧限制再读可见工具集，否则换到更大的档位只会越裁越少；每个 disposer 都注册在 `ctx.effect` 上，不这么做热重载会留下一条撤不掉的限制。实测（12GB 笔记本显卡跑 27B、256K 全驻留，同一段对话）：105 个工具 / 56,306 prompt token / decode 22.5 tok/s，关掉三个工具重的插件后 62 / 34,207 / 43.0，某个会话套上 local 档后 14 / 12,890 / 66.8，prefill 从 487 升到 1,310 tok/s。裁工具面还会连带去掉技能目录注入，再省约 4.3K token。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Moves every shell-deletion target into a per-Session staging folder and refuses the original command, keeps one pre-write copy of each file the first time it is overwritten, and adds a right-Sidebar tab that previews, restores, recycles or permanently deletes staged items. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把每条 shell 删除命令的目标移入本 Session 暂存夹并拒绝原命令，文件首次被覆写时保留一份副本，右侧栏分页可预览、还原、送入回收站或永久删除。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Right-click a conversation and delete it after two confirmations. Removes the session directory, workspace accounting (archive and pin entries) and the projection cache; refuses while the conversation is still running. Supports DSH >=0.2.2-rc.3 <0.3.0. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 会话右键菜单里的「删除会话」：两次确认后删除。会删掉会话目录、工作区账本（归档与置顶集合）和投影缓存，仍在运行的会话拒绝删除。适用 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.3 <0.3.0。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: One-click session title regeneration for the current session: a labelled button beside the title, a row in the session header menu, the /retitle command, and a retitle_session agent tool, all calling the composed session-title service's explicit refresh.
description.zh: 一键重新生成当前会话的标题：标题旁的按钮、会话头部菜单里的一行、/retitle 命令，以及 retitle_session 智能体工具，都调用当前组合的会话标题服务的显式刷新。

description.en: Sidebar density controls for DeepSeek Harness: row height, spacing, font size, logo size, new-session height, double-column plugins, plus patch-gated caption height/font and unlocked sidebar width. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 左侧栏密度调节：会话行高、插件按钮行高与间距、字号、Logo 尺寸、新会话按钮高度、插件双栏，拖动即时生效；另有顶栏高度/字号与左栏宽度上限三项，需配套 asar 补丁才生效。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A right-sidebar narrator for DeepSeek Harness that says what the agent finished, is doing, and will do next, plus a read-only explain channel, a non-interrupting steer, and a stop that reports what it kept. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 右侧栏三行话，说清它干完什么、在干什么、下一步干什么；另有只读提问、不打断的提醒、以及把代价讲清楚再喊停。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Builds, wires, compiles and simulates Simulink models inside the MATLAB session you already have open. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在你已经开着的 MATLAB 会话里建 Simulink 模型、连线、编译与仿真。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Switch each agent skill between on, user-only, and off from a composer popover and a Settings page, writing only the SKILL.md invocation fields, with the host inventory of every visible skill and a skill_manager tool for the agent.
description.zh: 在输入框弹层和设置页里把每个 agent 技能切换为「全开 / 仅用户 / 已关闭」，只改写 SKILL.md 的调用字段；列出宿主可见的全部技能，并提供 skill_manager 工具。

description.en: Five switchable interface skins, each with its own animated boot sequence and synthesized sound design.
description.zh: 五套可切换的界面皮肤，每套配专属开机动画与合成音效。

description.en: MCP server manager in the DSH settings panel: lists, adds, edits, removes and enables or disables the mcp-client loader entries, with each in-flight phase shown separately and unsaved drafts never committed behind your back.
description.zh: DSH 设置面板里的 MCP 服务管理器：列出 / 新增 / 编辑 / 删除 / 启停 mcp-client loader 条目；每个中间状态各自显示，且未保存的草稿不会被悄悄提交。

description.en: Read-only split-rule acceptance for DeepSeek Harness: point it at a Clash/Mihomo profile plus a JSON suite of expected routes (direct / proxy / block or a concrete policy) and it walks the rules in their real order, reporting per domain the expected route, the matched rule with its index and raw text, and what actually happens. Rules that need DNS, an IP-geo database or phone runtime state are marked as undecidable offline instead of guessed. Optional baseline diff checks that domestic direct routes did not move. Ships an agent tool, a conversation-view panel, a CLI with exit codes, and a self-contained HTML report. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, writes no device configuration. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给「手机连家里 Wi-Fi 自动分流」做只读验收：读一份 Clash/Mihomo 配置和一份 JSON 用例（direct / proxy / block，或具体策略名），按规则真实顺序逐条求值，输出每个域名的期望、实际命中规则（序号+原文）与最终策略。需要 DNS、IP 地理库或手机运行时状态的规则明确标为无法离线判定，不猜；可选基线对比检查国内直连有没有变。带 agent 工具、会话视图面板、带退出码的 CLI 和自包含 HTML 报告。零运行时依赖、不联网、不写任何设备配置。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Treats empty-string or whitespace-only provider, model and reasoning_effort arguments on the subagent, subagent_fork and list_subagent_models tools as omitted, so DSH falls back to the parent route instead of rejecting the call.
description.zh: 把 subagent、subagent_fork 与 list_subagent_models 工具的 provider、model、reasoning_effort 参数里的空字符串或纯空白视为未提供，让 DSH 回退到父路由，而不是直接拒绝这次调用。

description.en: Two-stage approval gate for outbound WeChat replies in DeepSeek Harness: every reply is staged as an editable local draft that keeps the quoted original and its voice-transcription source/confidence; only a panel confirmation or /send <id> releases it through a configured bridge, and unconfirmed drafts expire with a recorded reason. Dry-run by default, JSONL audit, zero dependencies. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 微信出站两级审批闸门：Agent 的回复先落成本机可编辑草稿，保留引用原文与语音转写来源/置信度；只有面板「确认发送」或 /send <id> 才经配置的桥接真正发出，未确认草稿到期自动作废并记录原因。默认演练模式、JSONL 审计、零运行时依赖。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Sizes and centres the DSH desktop window to a share of the screen on launch, adjustable from Settings > General. Windows only. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 启动时按屏幕比例缩放并居中 DSH 桌面窗口，可在设置 → 通用 里直接改比例。仅 Windows。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Per-workspace plugin and skill gating for DSH. Arm one workspace to freeze its exact plugin and skill set, and every other workspace automatically loses what that workspace does not use.
description.zh: DSH 工作区级插件与技能门控。锁定一个工作区的插件/技能集合后，其它工作区会自动失去该工作区不使用的部分。

description.en: Workspace-scoped persistent memory for DSH, laid out like Claude Code's auto-memory: one English-slug Markdown file per memory beside a MEMORY.md index under ~/.dsh/projects/, with hybrid vector+keyword recall, three automatic triggers (index injected every turn, file-path hints appended to tool results, per-message prefetch), a review queue for low-confidence writes so nothing enters the library silently, and global preferences written as numbered chapters into ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md under a byte budget. Everything is read from and written to local files; the optional leanvec embedder (~85 MB, installed locally by the bundled script) powers semantic recall but runs in-process, so the plugin itself opens no network connections and uploads nothing. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 工作区级持久记忆，布局仿 Claude Code 的 auto-memory：一条记忆一个英文 slug 的 Markdown 文件，平铺在 MEMORY.md 索引旁，存放在 ~/.dsh/projects/ 下；检索是向量加关键词混合，三个触发点全自动（每轮注入索引、工具结果里按文件路径附提示、用户发消息时预取），低置信度的写入先进待确认队列，不会静默入库；跨项目偏好则按编号章节写进 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 并受字节预算约束。数据全部读写本地文件；可选的 leanvec 嵌入模型（约 85 MB，由随包脚本本地安装）负责语义召回，但只在进程内运行，插件本身不发起网络请求、不上报任何数据。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Status-first workspace board for the DSH sidebar: sorts workspaces and tasks by needs-input, running, then done; adds search, same-status drag ordering, task archive/restore, and three distinct status markers.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏工作区改成按「需要介入 → 执行中 → 已完成」排序的状态看板：提供工作区/任务搜索、同状态内拖拽排序、任务归档与恢复，并用三种醒目状态标识实时更新。

description.en: Zotero plugin for DeepSeek Harness: browse and search your library, read PDFs with annotations and highlights in a right-sidebar tab, export BibTeX and RIS citations, and drive the same actions through 19 agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Zotero 插件：在右侧标签内浏览检索文库、阅读带注释与高亮的 PDF、导出 BibTeX 与 RIS 引文，并通过 19 个 Agent 工具完成同样的操作。

description.en: Codex-style composer model picker: a card showing the current model and a draggable slider that sets reasoning effort, with one stop per level the model advertises and an Off stop when the provider supports it. The slider snaps only to whole stops and updates the effort label while dragging. Up to three configurable model+effort pairs sit beside it as one-click quick-switch chips, configured in the plugin's own popover. Model and effort switches still go through the session model directory, so they stay in sync with the rest of the composer.
description.zh: Codex 风格的输入框模型选择器：卡片显示当前模型，底部用可拖动的滑杆设置推理强度，每个档位都对应模型真实声明的推理等级（提供商支持时有 Off 档），滑杆只停在整档上，拖动过程中文字即时更新。旁边最多三个可配置的「模型+推理强度」快捷切换按钮，单击一次同时切换两者，在该插件自己的设置弹层里配置。模型与档位的切换仍走会话的模型目录，与输入框其他部分保持同步。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for effort & token insights by date and workspace, plus multi-device sync. DSH 工作量报告插件：按日期与工作区看清「我的付出」与 Token 消耗，含日历热力图 / 时刻分析 / 工作区占比 / 模型用量，可导出自包含 HTML 报告，并支持多设备用量同步（COS / GitHub / Gitea / 共享目录）。
description.zh: 按日期和工作区统计你的投入与 Token 消耗，用日历热力图看清时间和钱都花在哪了。

description.en: Finance Ops suite: one-command install for dsh-einvoice, dsh-bankrec, dsh-ap-three-way and dsh-travel-recon.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐发票、银行对账、三单匹配和差旅报销四个财务插件，财务日常一次搞定。
在 DSH 里统一管理 MCP 服务器，一键安装、启停和配置，让外部工具接入更省心。
给会话加个回收站，当前会话一键移入，误删的能恢复，不要的也能彻底删掉。
